text: This proposed motion is intended to address safety concerns for all road users, particularly children, seniors, pedestrians, and cyclists using Birchcliff Avenue and Freeman Street. This intersection is a key travel route for students and families walking to and from Birch Cliff Public School, and residents have raised concerns about driver behaviour and the potential for serious collisions. All-way compulsory stop controls are a proven traffic calming tool that help reduce vehicle speeds, clarify right-of-way, and create safer crossing opportunities for pedestrians at residential intersections. Although not technically warranted at this location, implementing an all-way stop at Birchcliff Avenue and Freeman Street will improve safety, support active school travel, and enhance the quality of life for residents. The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Birchcliff Avenue and Freeman Street.
